-- W1: HubSpot Lead Enrichment
SELECT 'HubSpot Lead Enrichment' AS workflow_name, 
       CASE WHEN error_message IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'success' END AS status, 
       received_at AS run_timestamp
FROM lead_enrichment_runs
WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W2: Shopify Order Confirmation
SELECT 'Shopify Order Confirmation', 
       CASE WHEN error_message IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'success' END, 
       processed_at
FROM shopify_webhook_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W3: Shopify to HubSpot Sync
SELECT 'Shopify to HubSpot Sync', 
       CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 'failed' ELSE status END, 
       started_at
FROM customer_sync_runs
WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W4: Airtable to Notion Sync
SELECT 'Airtable to Notion Sync', 
       CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 'failed' ELSE status END, 
       run_started_at
FROM airtable_notion_sync_runs
WHERE run_started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W5: Stripe Payment Fan-Out
SELECT 'Stripe Payment Fan-Out', 
       overall_status, 
       processed_at
FROM stripe_payment_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W6: Google Calendar to Slack
SELECT 'Google Calendar to Slack', 
       slack_post_status, 
       processed_at
FROM gcal_meeting_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W7: Spreadsheet Validation
SELECT 'Spreadsheet Validation', 
       CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN status = 'committed' THEN 'success' ELSE 'partial' END, 
       processed_at
FROM spreadsheet_import_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W8: Canvas Deadline Aggregator
SELECT 'Canvas Deadline Aggregator', 
       slack_post_status, 
       processed_at
FROM canvas_digest_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

UNION ALL

-- W9: Multi-Tenant Payment Notifications
SELECT 'Multi-Tenant Payment Notifications', 
       slack_post_status, 
       processed_at
FROM tenant_payment_runs
WHERE processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';
